en: Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a small-town street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks; children stand and play in the street and several horse‑drawn carts move down the unpaved road. The façades show shop signs in German script. At the top, in red print, is the caption identifying the town and district: "Mügeln, Bez. Leipzig."
